stories.headline: RBI rules to compensate digital fraud victims from Jan 1, 2027
points: Victims get 85% of net loss or ₹25,000, whichever is lower, if the fraud is up to ₹50,000; once per lifetime.
Rules start January 1, 2027 and stay in force for one year. Banks must now prove customer liability in disputed e-transfers.
For maximum compensation, report to the bank within five calendar days and also file on the cyber crime portal or 1930.
stories.why_it_matters: Fraud liability, bank compensation rules and reporting timelines are part of banking law and compliance work CA/CMA students handle.
stories.source_title: RBI digital fraud new rules Jan 1, 2027: How much compensation can you claim? Check complaint filing deadline
check_notes: The 'Why it matters' line about CA/CMA students is the outlet's own framing and doesn't come from the source. It isn't a factual error, but it is unsupported commentary.
'Disputed e-transfers' is a loose paraphrase. The source says the rule covers complaints about fraudulent electronic banking transfers (EBTs), such as POS, ATM, phone, internet and card transactions.

stories.headline: ICAI bars CA for three months over medical trust audit disclosure
points: ICAI's Disciplinary Committee reprimanded CA Bikash Kumar Gupta, removed his name for three months and fined him ₹1 lakh.
The complaint concerned his audit of the Shipping Corporation of India Post-Retirement Medical Trust for FY 2016-17.
Medical expense reimbursement rose to ₹12,38,02,297 from ₹47,33,930, with the merger of two schemes allegedly not explained.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows that auditors must ensure clear disclosure of material transactions, even when management already knows about them.
stories.source_title: CA, CS, CMA | ICAI Removes CA for Three Months Over ₹12.38 Crore Trust Disclosure Failure

stories.headline: ICAI reprimands CA and fines ₹2 lakh over audit lapses
points: ICAI Disciplinary Committee reprimanded CA Gopal Subhashchandra Saboo and fined him ₹2 lakh, payable within 60 days.
It found he did not properly contact the previous auditor before accepting the FY 2017-18 audit of Santosh Packaging.
It also found independence concerns and not enough audit evidence; he admitted his mistake and sought leniency.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows that incoming auditors must communicate with the previous auditor themselves, stay independent and keep proper audit evidence.
stories.source_title: CA, CS, CMA | ICAI Reprimands CA, Imposes ₹2 Lakh Fine for Audit Misconduct
